project.name: DeadDraw
project.concept: A zombie survival solo card-crawl roguelite: each street deals 4 cards (zombies, weapons, medkits), you resolve 3 and carry 1 forward or flee, and runs across a ruined city unlock survivors and perks.
project.competitors: Scoundrel (solitaire card game), Card Crawl, Balatro
project.unique_selling_point: The quick, readable one-deck solitaire crawl rules grown into a zombie roguelite with survivors, perks and a city map, playable in one hand on a phone browser.

development_rules: Godot 4.4.1 GDScript, exported to Web (HTML5); must run in a phone browser in portrait and landscape
Every card can be inspected with right click or long press
Original art and names only; no assets or names copied from existing games

risks.mitigation: Strict feature freeze after design phase
